P1_depolarizing_bell_endpoints.note: p=0: I_c=log(2) (no channel); p=1: I_c<0 (maximally mixed B collapses coherent info)

P2_depolarizing_sweep_monotone.note: I_c is monotone non-increasing as depolarizing p increases from 0 to 1 (DPI sweep)

P3_z3_DPI_violation_impossible.note: UNSAT: I_c_out > I_c_in requires delta_AB < delta_B, which violates the CPTP joint-entropy constraint. DPI confirmed.

N1_z3_dephasing_cannot_increase_Ic.note: UNSAT: dephasing I_c > original I_c contradicts CPTP joint entropy constraint + non-decreasing B marginal entropy. Dephasing cannot increase coherent information.

N2_cvc5_DPI_crosscheck.note: cvc5 UNSAT: independent encoding confirms DPI violation impossible. I_c_after > I_c_before contradicts CPTP channel entropy constraints.

B1_identity_channel_Ic_preserved.note: Identity channel: I_c preserved exactly (DPI boundary — equality case)

B2_unitary_channel_Ic_preserved.note: Hadamard unitary on B: I_c preserved (DPI equality for reversible channels)

B2b_sympy_unitary_Ic_invariant.note: sympy: unitary preserves both S(B) and S(AB) — I_c invariant under unitary channel
